title: Task F1813: Method A / A.2 Unified Framework Synthesis and Comprehensive Benchmark Assessment
review_directive: Task F1813: Method A / A.2 Unified Framework Synthesis and Comprehensive Benchmark Assessment. Synthesize the completed single-pass (Method A.1) and multi-state (Method A.2) work across all four benchmarks into one definitive comparison package, using the F1812 framework (4276A5DC...) with MultiStateRecoveryDonorBuilder as the unified framework. For each case, tabulate the campaign progression F1808 -> F1809 -> F1811 -> F1812 (element counts, error targets, quad fractions, Jacobians, aspect ratios, coarsening ratios, and critical-region resolution), and state explicitly whether the Method A goal is met: all four scientific gates now PASS (Case 1 full ligament 97.19% <= l0/2 at 25,461 elements; Case 2 outer ligament 100.00% <= l0/2 at 41,438; Case 3 secondary corridor 93.84% <= l0 at 77,779; Case 5 inter-hole 99.04% <= l0 at 15,466). Document the remaining gaps honestly and explicitly, with no gate redefinition hidden in a rename: (1) Gate 06 still FAILS for Cases 2 (1.55x) and 3 (1.65x) against the 2.0x threshold; (2) Gate 07 changed from a universal <= 30,000 elements in F1811 to per-case budgets in F1812 (Case 1 <= 30k, Cases 2/3 <= 80k) — state this change and the reason plainly; (3) source donor ODBs over 100 MB (including PK_F1769_C1_DONOR.odb, 725 MB) are excluded from git per repository policy, so their damage-state values rest on the execution reports, not on committed ODBs — record the provenance chain and the exact HPC scratch paths; (4) no coupled fracture (Job-2) validation has yet been run on the adapted meshes, so the meshes are qualified as adapted discretizations, not as validated fracture simulations. Produce one synthesis report and one comparison figure set (per-case progression chart and a 4-panel synthesis figure) that a reader can use to judge the campaign without re-reading every task report. Commit the synthesis report and figures with hashes computed from the committed files; copy commit SHAs from the GitHub API ref, never transcribe them; use repo-relative paths and the PRVSTUDENT/adaptive-remeshing-phase-field-thesis repo in every link. No new PBS jobs; cumulative 35 preserved. No change to the frozen production UEL. Do not start coupled fracture validation or any new PBS work in this task.
